target_rule: success remains clean-test-v2 Dice > 0.9317660066557425; clean-test-v2 items in this manifest are diagnostic references only

dataset_policy.next_variant_rule: create an isolated corrected/verified hard-case train/val variant only after human decisions are filled

rationale: R126 hard-case sampler underperformed R117/R110, so the current hard pool is not sufficient as weighting signal.
R125 hard-train prototypes are dominated by shared-failure, bridge, and underreach-like cases rather than candidate-fixable cases.
Use severe feature outliers and hard-case tags to prioritize manual label/protocol review before another training run.

human_decision_schema.minimum_gate_for_R134_variant: at least 20 train cases reviewed with >=8 confirmed corrections or protocol-clear hard examples; val-audit reviewed separately
